title: Replacement Ticket Balance after Adjustment Credit — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Replacement ticket balance — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** For the one-tire replacement ticket written for an adjusted tire, the balance is the tire line less the credit applied, plus the mounting line, plus the line's scrap tire handling fee per tire, rounded half up to the cent; it is figured before tax.

- **Credit remaining** — the credit issued by every treadwear adjustment entry of the set, less every credit-applied and credit-expired entry of the set.
- **Tire line** — the store's selling price of the same tire recorded on the set's latest treadwear adjustment.
- **Credit applied** — the smaller of the credit remaining and the tire line; it reduces only that tire line, never installation charges, fees or tax. A set with no treadwear adjustment entry has no credit and no recorded selling price, and both count as 0.
- **Mounting line** — the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire.
- **Valve stem or TPMS kit** — rung from the vehicle record when the tire is mounted; not part of this balance.

No intermediate figure is rounded; the balance is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

| Worked (hypothetical ticket) | Figure |
|---|---|
| Recorded selling price (tire line) | $160.00 |
| Credit remaining on the set | $45.30 |
| Credit applied | $45.30 |
| Mount and balance | $25.00 |
| Scrap tire handling fee | $3.75 |
| Balance before tax | $160.00 less $45.30, plus $25.00, plus $3.75: $143.45 |

With $190.00 of credit remaining against the same tire line, the credit applied is $160.00 and the balance is $28.75.
